meta.name: WealthSmith Primitive Shadow Tokens
meta.description: Raw shadow values for the WealthSmith design system. These tokens define elevation depth and should be mapped to semantic usage in tokens/semantic/shadow.json.

xs.description: Very subtle shadow for small raised UI details

sm.description: Subtle shadow for cards and low-emphasis surfaces

md.description: Default elevation shadow for panels, dropdowns, and interactive surfaces

lg.description: Large shadow for elevated overlays and prominent panels

xl.description: Extra-large shadow for modals, drawers, and high-emphasis overlays

focus.description: Focus ring shadow for keyboard and accessibility states
